_about: SINGLE CONTROL DOCUMENT for the whole platform. Edit this one file to re-brand it, set your school's details (name, logo, contact, social links), change standard wording (welcome messages, footer, errors), or toggle which dynamic widgets/badges appear. Loaded by core.branding; exposed to every template as `brand` / `org` / `dynamic` / `site` / `strings` (see core.context_processors.branding) and to Python via `from core.branding import t, BRAND, ORG`. Placeholders like {name} are filled with str.format() — keep them.
_sections: ORGANISATION (your details + logo + contact + social) → see `brand`.  STANDARD WORDING → `brand.welcome`, `meta`, `auth`, `messages`, `errors`, `footer`.  DYNAMIC ELEMENTS (badges/widgets/banner you can turn on/off) → `dynamic`.  CUSTOM SITE-WIDE VALUES injected into every page → `site`.

brand._favicon_note: Leave `favicon` EMPTY to use the generated set in static/images/icons/ (favicon-16/32/180) — browsers then pick the right size per context, which is why the tab icon stays sharp. Set it to a single path only if you want to override all of them with one file.

dynamic._about: Turn the live, data-driven elements of the UI on/off from here. `badges` control the unread/pending counters; `widgets` control floating/quick tools; `announcement` shows a site-wide banner. Read in templates as `dynamic.badges.*` etc.

landing._about: The public landing page (templates/pages/landing.html). `nav` is the in-page jump list shown in the floating navbar — each `href` MUST match an id= on a section of that page. `footer_programmes` is the left footer column.

site._about: Arbitrary site-wide values injected into EVERY template context (as `site.<key>`). Add anything you want available everywhere — a promo line, a phone for the header, a banner image — without touching code.

fees_policy: Fees are paid strictly in advance on the first of each month, over 12 months — including during school holidays. Monthly payments are a payment structure, not based on attendance.
Registration (new learners), the annual levy and the first month's fees are due on enrolment. The levy must be settled in full by 25 January.
Pay the full annual fees on or before 31 January and receive a 5% discount on the annual school fees.
Sibling discount: 5% on school fees (not levy or registration) from the second child onwards.
Registration is non-refundable. Refunds otherwise incur a 5% charge.
The school does not accept cash. Pay at any Standard Bank (Killarney branch, account 002181282) using the learner's name and grade as the reference, or use the card machine at the school office.
One full term's notice is required when a learner leaves the school.
levy_covers: Computer coding, robotics and AI resources and classes
Mobile science labs and curriculum resources
All writing books, pencils, crayons and basic stationery
Printing paper and printing costs for worksheets and workbooks
Badges, trophies and certificates (not blazer badges)
SMSWEB communication to parents (sms and e-mail)
Competition entries (Conquesta, Battle of the Books, Story Skirmish, Olympiads, benchmark tests)
school.paper_note: All learners must bring one ream of Typek paper in January and one in July.
required_documents: Birth certificate (up to Grade 9) or ID / passport / asylum document (Grade 10 – 12)
Transfer card — SA-SAMS report (South African learners) or transfer card (non-South African learners)
Copy of parent payslip (confidential — supports fee responsibility)
school.enrolment_note: The application is pending until payment is received. Final registration is only completed once UCS receives a copy of the transfer card and final report directly from the previous school.
